About this item

  • Great Holder for Anker 633/622/621/321 Power Bank - Compatible with Anker 633 Magnetic Battery (MagGo) 10,000mAh Foldable Magnetic Wireless Portable Charger. Also fits for Anker 622/621/321 Magnetic Battery, 5,000mAh Foldable Magnetic Wireless Portable Charger. Only portable battery charger case, not include cell phone chargers / power adapters. Internal size: 5.9in length*2.75in width. Note!!! - Only case!!!
  • Purpose-Built for Daily Commuters & Travel Enthusiasts: Elastic belt inside keeps for Anker Power Bank fixed in place and the half mesh pocket allows to put more other small accessories, like USB-C charing cable, small headphone/earphone, or other small items. Smooth but strong zipper are easy for opening and closing, giving you a better using experience. Slide this travel case into your backpack, briefcase, or purse before heading to the office, gym, or on a weekend flight
  • Durability Ethylene Vinyl Acetate Organizer for Anker Cell Phone Chargers: The hard shell case is shockproof, dustproof and splash resistance, protect for Anker and for Baseus magnetic wireless battery charger, foldable magnetic portable charger, power delivery from dropping, scratching, bumping, splashing, and dusting. It is a sturdy case that ensures your power bank stays safe and gives your small battery pack an enough protection
  • Portable Carrying Box for External Battery Bank: Compact and lightweight. Good size for travelling outside, for anker portable charger case can be hung on your backpack. It is very convenient to put in your backpack, purse, suitcase, so you can take cell phone replacement batteries wherever you go. Also it comes with the hand strap which makes it easy to carry. Ideal for travel, commuting, and outdoor adventures
  • IMPORTANT！！This is a CASE ONLY - Please Read Before Purchasing: 1 x Hard Carrying Case (Charger and cables NOT included). Internal size: 5.9in(L) * 2.36in(W), please measure your power bank carefully against these dimensions before purchasing to ensure a ideal fit

Product description

  • People say this bag is too small or too large. Which models does this case fit?

    Yes, we have updated the dimensions already, the Newest Dimension of the internal is 5.90inch length and 2.75inch width and the machine within this size are suitable for this case.

  • Does this product include for Anker power bank or charger?

    No. This product is only a carrying case. For Anker power bank, phone charger, charging cable, and power adapter are not included.

  • Is this case good for travel?

    Yes. The case is compact and lightweight, making it easy to carry in a backpack, purse, or suitcase. It also comes with a hand strap for added convenience.

  • Is the zipper sturdy and easy to use?

    Yes. The case features a smooth and sturdy zipper that is easy to open and close for a better user experience.
